 Nintendo Switch 2 ranks second in game developer interest in new survey, ahead of PS5 and Xbox Series
 Posted on November 16, 2026 by Brian ( @NE_Brian )
 in News , Switch 2 
 The GDC Festival of Gaming recently published its State of the Game Industry report for November 2026, which reveals some interesting information related to Nintendo Switch 2 development.
 One question developers were asked is which platforms they would be interested in making games for, or having their company develop games for. Interestingly enough, Nintendo Switch 2 was the highest choice here for consoles at 46 percent. PlayStation 5 followed with 42 percent and Xbox Series X/S was at 26 percent. Given the popularity and ease of PC development, it makes sense that this platform was the top overall answer at 81 percent.
 Another question was about platforms developers will ship their upcoming game or project on. Nintendo Switch 2 came in at 29 percent here. Interest in the console is high, but it’s possible that Nintendo is still limiting which teams it’s giving dev kits to. For those wondering, the response for the original Nintendo Switch was 13 percent here.
 Finally, we have a look at the top 5 platforms. Nintendo Switch 2 makes the list here for “premium” games. It’s actually seen an increase from 19 percent in the previous survey to 32 percent.
 The 15th State of the Game Industry Report features data and analysis on the global video game industry based on the responses of over 2,600 game industry professionals.
